subject: Minor fix for dual rdb channel connection conn error log (#2658)
reason: The change only corrects which connection's last-error string is interpolated into a warning log message when the dual-channel RDB connection fails to connect (connGetLastError(server.repl_rdb_transfer_s) instead of server.repl_transfer_s). The surrounding error-handling control flow (connClose, resetting repl_rdb_transfer_s, syncWithPrimaryHandleError) is unchanged, so there is no observable behaviour difference in replies, replication, failover, persistence, or data integrity — only log text, which the fuzzer's oracles do not compare. No scenario is needed.
